external_collaboration.partner_name: Vienna Chamber of Commerce and Industry
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Vienna Chamber of Commerce and Industry, as the founder of Modul University Vienna, has a rich history of supporting education. With 150 years of educational experience, it is the largest operator of private schools in Austria and a prominent organization for adult education in the country. Each year, the Vienna Chamber of Commerce and Industry's educational institutes teach over 70,000 students, contributing significantly to the educational landscape of Austria.
